message.content:
Cleanup in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 + Prisma). Fix feature/marketing discrepancies. Do NOT edit lib/actions-account.ts (another task owns it), do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma, do NOT run git. Read files before editing.

1. **Replace `revsports.ca` leftovers** — the old brand appears as an `APP_URL` fallback default and in sample data. Change every fallback default and literal to `https://nxeon.cloud` (or `nxeon.cloud`). Grep: `grep -rn "revsports" /opt/nxeon --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v node_modules`. Fix them ALL EXCEPT lib/actions-account.ts (skip it — owned elsewhere). Key ones: app/opengraph-image.tsx (the customer-visible social-share image literally renders "revsports.ca" — fix it), app/sitemap.ts, app/robots.ts, app/layout.tsx, components/marketing/StructuredData.tsx, app/status/page.tsx, lib/blog.ts, lib/email-render.ts, app/dashboard/affiliate/page.tsx, app/dashboard/refer/page.tsx, app/(marketing)/compare/page.tsx, app/(marketing)/vps-vs-*, components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor.tsx, app/admin/email-templates/page.tsx.
2. **Business-email marketing prices decoupled from DB** — app/(marketing)/business-email/page.tsx hardcodes tiers (Starter $1.99, etc.) while the portal sells `db.emailPlan` records. Make the marketing page render its tiers from `db.emailPlan` (mirror how app/(marketing)/pricing or vps pages read plans from the DB), so an admin edit can't desync marketing from checkout. Keep the "rolling out / reserve" framing if present. Make the page async/dynamic as needed.
3. **Two dead feature flags** — `feature_referrals` and `feature_newsletter` are admin-toggleable but never enforced. Enforce them: (a) when `feature_newsletter` is off, don't render the newsletter signup (find where `NewsletterSignup` is mounted — likely a marketing layout/footer — and gate it on `getSettingBool("feature_newsletter", true)`); (b) when `feature_referrals` is off, hide the "Refer & earn" and "Affiliate" nav items in app/dashboard/layout.tsx and guard their actions (add a `getSettingBool("feature_referrals", true)` check to the refer/affiliate server actions' entry, refusing when off). Mirror how the existing enforced flags (feature_domains/feature_game_servers/feature_claude_builder) are checked.

Note: app/dashboard/layout.tsx is shared — only touch the referral/affiliate nav gating there, preserve everything else (Tools section, badges, existing structure).

Verify: `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` clean and `npm run build` exits 0. Report files changed + how you verified the flags now gate.

`app/(marketing)/business-email/page.tsx` no longer hardcodes tiers. A `tierFromPlan` helper maps each DB record to the view-model: cadence from `termMonths`, features generated from `mailboxes`/`storageGB`, tagline via a name-keyed map with a graceful fallback. The middle tier is auto-marked "Most popular". Promo framing and the "rolling out / reserve" copy are preserved, plus an empty-state fallback if no plans exist.
